entities.name: Giant's Walk
entities.description: Zone of Ghirapur with locks and canals, on the migratory path of giants.

entities.name: Ghirapur

entities.name: Migrating giants
entities.description: Small group of giants that follow aether currents through Ghirapur twice a year.

events.summary: The giants' biannual passage becomes a celebrated migration festival where revelers paint the giants.
